observations: The page number «39» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L10 complete the second example, begun at the end of p. 38 (JP2 0070, L33-L34).

L01-L05 and L13-L17: the computations, set as on p. 38: the years («J.»), months («M.») and days («T.») in columns, repeated by ditto marks „, those after the days also under «der röm. Aera»; the sum below a rule. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the words room and are not printed. «Radjab» and «Shawwāl» are upright in the computations and in L08-L09 and L24, italic with their numbers in L11 and L25.

L01-L10. Checked: 390 Arab years are thirteen cycles of 10631 days; 1 Muḥarram 391 is 478903 days after 1 October 312 B.C., 1311 Julian years and 60¼ days, 1311 years 2 months ¼ day with months of thirty days. The 22 years 391-412 have eight leap years, 7796 days, 21 years 4 months 5¾ days; the first six months 177 days, 5 months 27 days. The sum less 5¼ days is 1333 years 0 months 1¾ days, which the text gives as 2 days: 1 October 1022 is 486878 days after the epoch, and 5 Radjab 413 is two days later, 3 October 1022, counted from 15 July 622.

L13-L26. Checked: the 8 years 391-398 have three leap years, 2835 days, 7 years 9 months 8¼ days; the first nine months 266 days, 8 months 26 days; the sum, 1319 years 7 months 36½ days, less 5¼ days, less four days for October, December, January and March and plus two for February, is 1319 years 7 months 29¼ days, and 7 months and 29 days after 1 October 1008 is 30 May 1009, the date that the day count from 15 July 622 gives for 3 Shawwāl 399. L27-L30: counted from 16 July 622 the three examples give 27 January 1126, 4 October 1022 and 31 May 1009, the dates of the modern tables.

L09: «3.» upright before the italic «Tishrīn I.»; L10: «3. Oktober» italic with its number. L28-L29: «Kh.», «Maslama» and «Batt.» spaced. L31: «3a», the a raised. L07: a speck at the foot of the e of «Summe»; not transcribed.
The colons, semicolons and the question mark stand after the thin space of the edition (10-14 px measured; «Summa :» 10 and 11 px, «d. H. ?» 10 px).
